learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the beautiful shapes of musical instruments and learn how to draw the magical sounds they make!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Musical instruments look amazing! A guitar has a curvy body, a drum is a big cylinder, and a flute is a long, thin tube with holes.
We cannot see sound in real life, but in art, we can draw wavy lines, spirals, and floating music notes to show that an instrument is playing loudly!
Different instruments are drawn with special details. We draw thin straight lines for strings on a sitar, and tight circles for the top of a tabla.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Draw the Loudest Drum!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a large, colorful drum. Now, use bright yellow and red markers to draw big lightning bolts and wavy lines exploding from it to show a SUPER LOUD beat!

quick_recap: ⭐ Every musical instrument has a unique shape, like cylinders or curvy bodies.
⭐ We can draw wavy lines and symbols to make sound visible on paper.
⭐ Adding tiny details like strings or keys makes instrument drawings look real.
